      "observations": [
        "Original caching landing reads platform cache-entry expiration rather than implementing HTTP header parsing. Cache expiration seconds are converted to relative milliseconds and clamped at zero; missing/zero/NO_EXPIRATION_TIME returns zero. A valid cache at init schedules its remaining time. Current structured loadFromCache/hasCache init result is later fixed behavior, not the original Boolean result.",
        "D231967 full creation-to-close/post-close timeline and all51 actual rows read. Reviewer flags dynamic canUpdate/offline and missing-callback exits stopping polling; author agrees and original landing schedules ten minutes before false return. Empty/about:blank URL intentionally returns without scheduling. Optional URL helper extraction, uncertain JSDoc separator/indent comments and test-only eager import are scoped suggestions, not global policy reversals.",
        "Current _fetch has separate success history and bounded failure backoff, unlike original default-interval failure scheduling. A false return does not identify whether another timer is pending. Current _schedule clears its owned handle before fetching; reuse existing exact timer lesson without attributing every later retry/rate-limit change to this patch.",
        "Reviewer reports cache-task isolation, callback-spy/call-count failures and a stale initialization assertion before conditional acceptance. Source outcomes include local cacheUrl instead of an ad-hoc member, scalar bounds/equality assertions and explicit two-schedule count; test-init currently primes its own cache. No linked Try/pass or developer test report becomes this worker execution.",
        "Current test_init_withRecentUpdate registers a new onUpdate spy but resets/asserts a different updateSpy. Its zero-count assertion alone therefore misses calls to the registered callback. Other initResult and scheduleSpy assertions remain separate useful oracles. Add a scoped proposed test-target correction; this is not an executed failure or claim the whole test is ineffective.",
        "Current callback is invoked without await, so synchronous thrown-error coverage does not establish rejection handling for later async promises. Keep existing async-boundary proposal separate from transport/JSON failures. Full retained original source/test study reused; no server/source dependency expansion."
